reviews.name: Deep Water and Buoy
reviews.premise: The sea the name comes from: a blue-green abyss and a pale shell, with buoy amber as the one light that says: this needs you.
logo_ideas: A lowercase o made of two half-rings, like two shell valves
An amber pearl held inside a sharp-tipped crescent
A solid rounded square split by a diagonal channel, joined at one hinge
